Here's a summary of the findings and changes made:

## Build Performance Analysis

**Baseline**: ~9s (failed due to analyzer errors) / ~2.7s (with analyzers disabled)
**After optimization**: ~2.3s Debug build succeeds cleanly

## Issues Found & Fixed

### 1. `Directory.Build.props` — Analyzers in dev inner loop
- `EnforceCodeStyleInBuild`, `TreatWarningsAsErrors`, and `GenerateDocumentationFile` were **always on**, slowing every keystroke-to-build cycle and breaking the build entirely
- **Fix**: Gated these behind `Configuration == Release` or `ContinuousIntegrationBuild == true`

### 2. Redundant transitive project references
- `BusinessLogic` → referenced both `DataAccess` and `Common` (Common is transitive via DataAccess)
- `WebApi` → referenced all 3 lower projects (only needs BusinessLogic)
- `Tests` → referenced all 4 projects (only needs WebApi)
- **Fix**: Removed redundant refs; MSBuild resolves transitive dependencies automatically

### 3. Duplicate `TargetFramework` declarations
- Every `.csproj` redeclared `<TargetFramework>net8.0</TargetFramework>`, already set in `Directory.Build.props`
- **Fix**: Removed duplicates

### 4. Excessive solution configurations
- 6 platform configs (Any CPU / x64 / x86) but all projects only target `Any CPU` — the x64/x86 entries just mapped to Any CPU
- **Fix**: Trimmed to 2 configurations (Debug|Any CPU, Release|Any CPU)

### Remaining recommendation
Add an `.editorconfig` to configure the IDE style rules (IDE0160, IDE0022, etc.) so Release/CI builds pass cleanly.
